items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: Pearl Bailey, was Step (inaudible)? on with us

ctx.x: Yeah ... (inaudible) and Pearl Bailey, was Step (inaudible)? on with us, and the Dailey Brothers, you remember them?
No, I don't have remember any of that. I was just wondering. I remember Dickie talking about playing for dancers gave you a kick, and playing the instrument gave you a kick.
